classification.difficultyReason: Use equal distances from the centre to infer equal chords, then recognise that the perpendicular bisects the chord and halve its length.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

children.label: s
children.prompt: The two chords are equally distant from $O$.

spec.description: Circle centred at O with two near-vertical chords, perpendicular centre-to-chord segments and right-angle squares. External dimensions identify the complete right chord as 15 cm and the lower half of the left chord as x. Decorative source colours are replaced by black.
spec.mathematics: The explicitly added equal-distance condition makes the chords equal. Each perpendicular from O bisects its chord, so x is half of 15 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x appear; the supplied 7.5 cm answer is omitted.

answer.worked:
Chords equally distant from the centre are equal, so the left chord is $15\text{ cm}$. The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord.
$$\begin{aligned}x&=\frac{15}{2}\\x&=7.5\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
